description: Two- or three-stage Delta variant with an RS-27A LOX/RP-1 first stage, up to nine GEM strap-on solid boosters, and an optional Star-48B kick stage for high-energy escape trajectories. 155 launches over 29 years with a 99.4% success rate; carried Dawn, Messenger, MRO, Phoenix, Kepler, Spitzer, GRAIL, and the original GPS Block II constellation. The 'Delta II Heavy' (7920H + Star-48B) was the configuration that delivered enough C3 for direct-to-Ceres + Mercury orbital insertion. Retired after the medium-lift market shifted to Atlas V and Falcon 9.
best_known_for: NASA's medium-lift planetary-science workhorse 1989-2018 — Dawn, Messenger, MRO, Phoenix, Kepler
